# Working with Local LLMs

<p class="when">{{< var event.date >}}, {{< var event.time >}} · {{< var event.where >}}</p>

Run AI models on your own computer instead of someone else's.
:::

## Before the session

1. **Look up your computer's memory (RAM) and graphics card.** On a Mac, open the Apple menu → **About This Mac**. On
   Windows, open **Settings → System → About**. We'll use them to choose a model that runs well on your machine.
2. **Install Ollama and the starter model** with the [Setup](setup.qmd) steps: about 10 minutes, plus a download. Can't
   do it ahead? We'll do it together at the start.

You don't need a powerful computer, and you're welcome to just watch.

## What we'll do

- Install Ollama, a free app for running open models, and download a small first model.
- Chat with it, and see how fast it runs on your computer.
- Learn how to choose a model that fits your computer, then download a second one and compare the two.
- Talk about why researchers want a local option, and the honest trade-offs in speed and capability.

## You'll leave with

A model running on your own computer, and the know-how to choose your next one.
